description:
Cross-platform encrypted email client Aster Mail is a cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted email client built for Aster Privacy. Features quantum-safe encryption and zero-knowledge architecture.

> [!NOTE] > These files are for new installations. If Aster Mail is already installed, it updates automatically. ## What's new • Labels can contain other labels, and changes to folders and labels appear on your other devices right away. • Message details show whether the sender passed authentication checks. • A message shows the tracking pixels that Aster Mail blocked, grouped by domain. • The inbox, opened messages, and the sign-in screen appear sooner. ## Fixed • When you search from Trash or Spam, Aster Mail searches that folder. • You can move messages out of Trash and Spam into the inbox or a folder. • Encrypted messages that didn't open before now open, including mail on accounts created in the iOS app. • Scheduled replies keep the sender address and the conversation that you chose. • Emails designed for a light background stay readable in dark mode.
